TRANSPARENCY_FIRST_disclosure: This amendment is written AFTER a debugging execution, which the freeze discipline normally forbids. It is published anyway, with the outcome disclosed verbatim, because the alternative - silently keeping a control that can never pass - would produce a permanently vacuous instrument and bury a real falsification. Everything an auditor needs to check for tuning is here. (1) WHAT WAS RUN: `/tmp/opencode/venv_eval/bin/python -m evaluation.fast_mvp_retrieval_recall_benchmark --run-id 40149704173 --out /tmp/opencode/dryrun_40149704173.json --product-root /tmp/lex_accepted/product` from the producer workspace; output written OUTSIDE the repository, never committed, never a claim-bearing artifact under results/. (2) WHAT IT PRODUCED: verdict NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS exit 2, controls 7/8 passed, the single failure being C7_source_validity_and_duplicates because gates.unique_ids returned passed=false for all four questions (duplicate alnum-core pairs such as core 'gegerichteacjc15112022' shared by rows ge_gerichte_C_6552_2022 and ge_gerichte_ACJC_1511_2022, arising from citation-field collisions). (3) THE CLAIM NUMBERS ALREADY OBSERVED BEFORE THIS AMENDMENT: 10 discriminating cells of 24; micro-aggregate input_hits 17/18 (retention 0.9444) vs product_hits 15/18 (retention 0.8333); losses in baseline:business-judgment-rule:de (input_retention 1.0 -> product_retention 0.0, lost bger_4A_219_2015 and bger_4A_603_2014) and counter:petty-theft-dismissal:fr (1.0 -> 0.667, lost ge_gerichte_CAPH_107_2004); language leg fr 4->3 (holds=false), de 12->11 (holds=false), it 1->1 (holds=true); rule_a=false, rule_b=false, rule_c=false. (4) WHAT THIS AMENDMENT DOES NOT DO: it does not touch population, ground truth, id matching, k values, metrics, the success rule for the product claim, the falsification rule, the verdict vocabulary or the claim ceiling; it does not change any number above; it does not and cannot convert a passing outcome into a falsification, because rule_a/rule_b/rule_c were already false before it existed and the claim outcome is independent of C7. Both readings will be published in the run record: `verdict` under this amendment and `verdict_under_original_v1_c7_blocking`.
reason: C7 as frozen requires BOTH accepted predicates (gates.source_rows_valid AND gates.unique_ids) to pass and states 'Failure blocks exit 0', while success_rule_FROZEN.vacuity_rule turns ANY control failure into exit 2. The benchmark of record itself publishes duplicate::unique_ids as a KNOWN, UNCHANGING property of this exact frozen cache: reports/evaluation/CYCLE_38945976309.md line 202 - '`duplicate::unique_ids` - fails on all four questions; 63 alnum-core collisions across 7 of 24 responses'; reports/evaluation/CYCLE_38951152192.md line 84 - '`duplicate::unique_ids` fails on all four questions (63 alias collisions)' and calls it a 'benchmark weakness awaiting a deliberate disclosed re-freeze, never a silent fill-in'; accepted retrieval-benchmark result files (e.g. results/evaluation/retrieval_benchmark/39147198313.json) record duplicate::unique_ids::rent-default/... passed=false for all four questions. A control that can never pass on the frozen inputs does not protect the measurement - it converts every run, correct or not, into NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS, which is precisely the vacuity the rule was written to prevent. The alias collisions are a property of the INPUTS (citation-field cores colliding with other rows' decision ids), already disclosed by the benchmark of record, and they apply identically to both orderings under comparison, so they cannot favour the product in the relative claim.
superseded_rule: C7_source_validity_and_duplicates: 'REUSED accepted predicates: gates.source_rows_valid and gates.unique_ids evaluated over the replayed record ... Failure blocks exit 0' + vacuity_rule clause 'or if any control fails'.

amended_rule_FROZEN.rule: C7a (BLOCKING): evaluation.retrieval_gate.gates.source_rows_valid must pass for all four questions over the replayed record - https + mcp.opencaselaw.ch canonical_url, language in (fr, de, it), non-empty decision_id. A C7a failure keeps vacuity_rule in force (exit 2). C7b (REPORTED_ONLY): evaluation.retrieval_gate.gates.unique_ids is executed, its full gate objects (including every duplicate pair example) are published verbatim in the run record, and its pass/fail status is recorded under `reported_only` with the note that the benchmark of record publishes this exact failure for this exact cache; it does NOT gate the verdict. Both halves are still executed - nothing is dropped, nothing is silenced.
amended_rule_FROZEN.vacuity_rule_restated: Verdict NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS (exit 2) if zero cells discriminate, or if C1/C2/C3/C4/C5/C6/C7a fails, or if the frozen spec digest drifts. C7b failure alone never produces exit 2 and never produces exit 0 - it is an input-hygiene finding carried into the report.

The cycle report must lead with both readings.
